notes.title: Changelog V1.77-1.89
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9792647/35db91c6826a9db8435d576c5bc4c76b64e36f7d.jpg[/img]

[b]New option: Gameplay Speed[/b]
- I have a good news for everyone, who found this game a bit too fast paced. There is a new requested option: 'Gameplay Speed'. It effects on the speed of units creation, base building, resource extraction, avatar’s level.

[b]Limit Of Units[/b]
- Now limit of units is dependent on the quantity of captured or created Energy Sources. On start your limit is 100 units. For each new Energy Source after 10, you will get 10 additional unit points (up to 200).
Note that different units has different crew coefficient: for soldier-class units it is 1, for tank-class units it is 2-3, for battleship-class units it is 10.

[b]Game Chat[/b]
- Now you can use chat even in the action mode: press button '`' to enable chat mode, then press 'Enter' to send message or exit chat mode.

[b]Requested Key-mapping changes[/b]
- Keys for rotating strategy camera: ‘Q/E’ or ‘Left Alt’ or ‘Mouse Wheel’ button.
- Activate button has been changed to 'F'.
- Find button has been changed to 'C'.
These and other keys can be changed in the launch menu, input section.

[b]Experimental Functions[/b]
- I just added this new option in the settings menu. It unlocks some new but not well tested features. So, you can use them at your own risk;)
The first of them is the ability to order buildings and airstrikes in the action mode. How it works:
Press F3 and you will see icons of bildings on the bottom-right side of the screen. 
Then press button 1-8 to order a building.
Press F4 and you will see icons of orbital strikes on the bottom-right side of the screen. 
Then press button 1-5 to order an airstrike.
You will see the progress on the mid-right and will be informed when it is done and ready to deploy. You still need to go to the strategy mode to deploy it.

[b]Hidden Enemy Troops[/b]
- Now hidden enemy troops are available in the multiplayer

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
- Starting level of energy increased by 20% for all the combat avatars.
- Attack speed and range of Berserks was increased.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed bug with AI stats and progress.
- Fixed with teams and factions in the multiplayer.
- Fixed bug with difficulty in the multiplayer.
- Fixed bug with the game physics.
- Fixed bug with camera for vehicles.
- Fixed bug with scrolling hosts list.
- Fixed bug with chat in the multiplayer.

[url=http://warshift.com/warshift_game_development_blog/] More updates you can see at the official development blog.[/url]

Thanks for playing and have fun!

notes.title: Alien Battleship & Docking Platform
notes.content:
[img]http://warshift.com/Steam/Acheron.jpg[/img]

[b]Alien Battleship[/b]

[img]http://warshift.com/Steam/ABattleship.jpg[/img]

Alien heavy battleship “Acheron” was designed for bombing the planet’s surface and assault operations. Weapons:
- x12 Ballistic plasma-bombs.
- x3 Pulsar cannons
- x2 Anti-air rocket launcher
- x1 Triton-class interceptor

[b]Alien Docking Platform[/b]

[img]http://warshift.com/Steam/ADock.jpg[/img]

The Docking Platform is designed for repair and logistic support to heavy warships. Along with this building, one battleship will be provided. The Docking Platform can repair a battleship and recharge its weapons. If the associated battleship is destroyed, you can order the delivery of a new ship. In the case of the destruction of this building, related ship will be destroyed too. Each team can have only one Docking Platform for use.

[b]Training Mission 4[/b]

https://youtu.be/SlJgS185m28

I this mission you will learn how to manage your ARK (assault carrier).
Then you will have some practice with aircraft and orbital strikes.

Thanks for playing and have fun!

[url=http://warshift.com/warshift_game_development_blog/warshift_got_3_new_units_armored_chivalry/2016-04-07-73] More updates you can see at the official development blog. [/url]

notes.title: New map ‘Winter Storm’, environment test
notes.content:
[img]http://warshift.com/Steam/Winterstorm1.jpg[/img]

 I worked hard to deliver this update and provide you with some snow in the game during this winter holidays:

https://youtu.be/Zs5BBz9n5Fs
 This is a new game map 'Winter Storm' on which I'm currently working. This large spacious game level has a lot of flat surfaces for base development and battles. It is not completely finished yet, it is just a test of winter environment. But you already can feel its frozen atmosphere. Hope you will enjoy it!

[img]http://warshift.com/Steam/Winterstorm2.jpg[/img]

[img]http://warshift.com/Steam/Winterstorm3.jpg[/img]

[b]Other updates:[/b]
- Now you can connect new Energy Sources to the selected Energy Source even if all its nodes are already used.
- Defensive shield on start. If you have chosen starting state 'Grounded ARK' - defensive shield will protect your and enemy base within 60 seconds. So you will have a bit of time at the start to customize your avatar and build your base safe. After that it will be disabled.
- New soundtracks
- Some balance changes
- A lot of bug fixing + adding new bugs :)

[b]Wish you all the best and a lot of fun during the holidays![/b]

notes.title: New combat avatar: T-Raptor, New video
notes.content:
[img]http://warshift.com/Steam/WARSHIFT-T-Raptor.jpg[/img]

[h1]New combat avatar: T-Raptor[/h1]

https://youtu.be/-qltMZDtto0
This is prototype of new combat avatar on which I'm working now: 
 T-Raptor is the most universal heavy assault drone that has the most diverse set of abilities and weapons. The main purpose of T-Raptor is to act on the ground. However, it also may effectively fight in the air and even underwater, but not for long time.  Its energy weapon consumes a lot of energy, but T-Raptor can use a melee weapons in close fight if level of energy is low.

[img]http://warshift.com/Steam/Warshift-T-Raptor-Dinosaur-Tyrannosaur-T-Rex.jpg[/img]

[img]http://warshift.com/Steam/Warshift-T-Raptor-Dragon-Hellicopter-Submarine.jpg[/img]

 [i]How will the T-Raptor play different from the Corsair?[/i] Corsair has only long range weapons so it was almost useless in close fight. But T-Raptor has in addition 2 kind of melee attacks + directed-energy weapon. For easier action in melee it has little different controls (especially turns & strafe) and appropriate set of animations. So, it is more universal combat avatar.

[h1]The development[/h1]

 Currently, it is still in progress, in playable prototype stage. So it is temporary unbalanced and may have some bugs, because I'm just recently finished work on T-Raptors artistic component. Check official development thread to see the process of creation: [url=http://warshift.com/forum/2-305-1]http://warshift.com/forum/2-305-1[/url]
Let me know if you have any ideas regarding T-Raptors weapons or abilities!

[h1]Other updates:[/h1]

- Now you can start creating Units, Buildings and Airstrikes in one click on the unit’s icon.
- Changing camera position: you can choose position between 3 points using mouse wheel (currently available only for T-Raptor and Corsair). Zoom/Sight via right mouse button is available as well.
- Fixed error of missiles aiming
- Balance changes

[h1]T-Raptor Gameplay tactict and strategy (Tips and Hints video)[/h1]

https://youtu.be/tCvhT2zrp7A
 This helpful video I made while testing of T-Raptor, in order to clarify its combat tactics and some aspects of the general strategy gameplay. This short let’s play shows some HINTS: how new combat avatar can win match without a lot of units or buildings, but using an interesting tactics and stratagem: changing position of the base for better logistics. Because military logistics playing one of the main roles in this game. This quick gameplay mostly focused on T-Raptor, Dreadnought and aircraft usage. 
[b](Please turn on annotations to see all TIPS and HINTS!)[/b]
 Next gameplay videos will be focused on ground armies, unique buildings, orbital strikes and other different strategies. Subscribe to [url=http://www.youtube.com/channel/UCt_1doFKr4YTKVKJRRmPtbA?sub_confirmation=1]official WARSHIFT Youtube channel[/url] to be up to date all with official news, tutorials and gameplay videos.

notes.title: Co-Op Mode (Playable prototype), Multiple enemy Avatars, V 1.37-1.38 updates.
notes.content:
[b]V 1.38 Co-Op Mode [Playable prototype][/b]
 Lately I received so many requests for Co-Op mode from people. With this in mind I decided to start developing it. And I'm already implemented in the game a playable prototype of Co-Op mode!
It currently supports 3 players per team:
- Server become a Commander who can control the base development and troops, and also he can control its own Avatar.
- Other players become a Combat avatars. They can control only their Avatars.
- On the enemy side can be 1 AI Commander and 1-3 AI Combat avatars. You can flexible setup quantity and type of enemy Avatars and other match settings.
[b]Multiple Enemy Avatars in Skirmish Mode[/b]
 In the single player skirmish mode you also can add to the enemy team 1-3 AI Combat avatars. And some campaign missions now has additional enemy Avatars on 'Hard' difficulty mode.
All this required to rework of many gameplay aspects. So, work is not finished yet. Also, skirmish GUI was little changed in accordance with the new requirements. 
Now I'm thinking how to implement ordering/targeting system for effective cooperation between Commanders and Avatars..

[b]V 1.37 Newest update.[/b]
- Strafe animation for ‘Corsair’.
- Selection of all allied troops on the level via ‘LeftCtrl+A’.
- Fixed bug with aiming in TPS/FPS mode.
- Difficulty presets for enemy AI. Now in 'Easy' mode enemy AI will start making air and artillery squads much later.
- Balance changes.

notes.title: Dev video diary #1. Patch notes: V 1.35 - V 1.31
notes.content:
[img]http://warshift.com/Steam/Update3.jpg[/img]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/392580

[b]VIDEO DIARY #1[/b]

https://youtu.be/Zc3CCtWHqzc

[b]New building: SCANNING PLATFORM[/b]

[img]http://warshift.com/_bl/0/62606637.jpg[/img]

Scanning Platform is an airborne radar picket system designed to detect enemy troops at long ranges. 
This structure provides several advantages:
- Unhides all the enemy troops around the map.
- Increases by 30% the distance for Orbital Strikes.
- Increases range of some weapons.
- Perhaps in the future this building will be endowed with additional functions.
Each team can have only one Scanning Platform for use.

[b]New building: WATCHTOWER[/b]

[img]http://warshift.com/_bl/0/90717546.jpg[/img]

(Alien analogue of Scanning Platform)

[b]GAMEPAD CONTROLS (Based on controller Xbox 360 Wired.)[/b]

This is really my first experience with gamepad (as developer and even as gamer), so I'll need advices during development :)

[img]http://warshift.com/Steam/WARSHIFT-Gamepad-Joystick-Controls.jpg[/img]

Note that controller input is disabled by default, so you have to enable it in the game settings menu ("Use gamepad" checkbox).
Currently only Action mode supports controller. Supports for other modes is still in development.

[b]FULL LIST OF RECENT CHANGES:[/b]

V 1.35 (28 Sep 2015)
- New buildings: Scanning platform, Watchtower
- Smooth zoom for strategy camera
- Now difficulty level affect on maximum health and maximum energy level
- Improved gamepad controls. Enable/disable gamepad option.
- Physical colliders removed from all small trees and stones
- Balance changes and bug fixes

V 1.33 (6 Sep 2015)
- Controller support for all Combat Avatars in the Action mode. Now you can check it even without beta access. Note, that other modes not supports controller yet.
- Improved AI for enemy Combat Avatars:
Now enemy Combat Avatars will retreat every time when <30% of their health left. Some kinds of Avatars can attack in movement during retreating. Corsair and Archangel will fly away.
Then, if hit points still <50% and there is no enemy near - Avatar will go to the ARK for instant repair. If enemy is near - Avatar will attack it as soon as at least 30% of hit points will be restored. 
Also, they sometimes retreat for a short time if all they weapons reloading or if energy low.
- Starting states:
No more pre-built buildings in the single player missions ‘Deep diving’ and ‘Fire in jungle’. Instead, you get a small army at the start.
‘Grounded ARK’ is now default starting state for skirmish matches and ‘Quick play’ mode.
(I hope that these changes will stimulate new players to use RTS mode more.)
- Bug fixes and balance changes.

V 1.32 (27 Aug 2015)
-Added repair function for buildings. Instant repair costs money and resources. Note, that it is unavailable if the enemy is near.
-Fixed bug with slow motion of Space Interceptors in RTS mode.
-Added more in-game tips and marks.
-Fixed bug with double playing video briefings in the single player campaign.
-Some other bug fixes and balance changes.

V 1.31 (17 Aug 2015)
- Bug with construction process is fixed now.
- Controls in the action mode. Speed of rotation/aiming is now increased for:
Gladiator: TPS +50%, FPS/Zoom + 50%
Corsair: grounded TPS +100%, grounded FPS/Zoom +200%, Air + 30%
Archangel: grounded TPS +100%, grounded FPS/Zoom +200%
Raider: rotational speed of the turret +100%
Arkar: TPS +50%, FPS/Zoom + 100%
Volcano: TPS +20%, FPS/Zoom + 20%
You can also reduce the speed of rotation using the mouse speed section in the settings menu, if you want.
- Now there is a ‘Respawn’ button, so you do not have to be distracted from the strategic gameplay. You can respawn manually when you will be ready.
- Strategy camera keeps its angle after Action/RTS switching and after focusing on the selected units.
- Added set of screen resolutions with ratio 16*10.
- Space gameplay: Now Dropships gives resources when they break through enemy's orbital defenses.
- Manually changing of destination point for automated factories.
- Balance changes and bug fixes

Thanks for playing and have fun!

More updates you can see at the official development blog: 
[url=http://warshift.com/blog]http://warshift.com/blog[/url]
